answer: The odds ratio for p53-mediated cell cycle gene regulation is approximately **4.5** (overlap 11 of 24 pathway genes among the 2,507 DE genes; Fisher 2x2 p ≈ 5e-4). IMPORTANT CAVEAT: this environment is fully air-gapped (no network, no gseapy installable), so this value was produced by the approved offline fallback — an Enrichr-style 2x2 contingency odds ratio (a=overlap, b=DE-not-in-set, c=set-not-DE, d=background remainder) using a literature-curated reconstruction of the Reactome_2022 "p53-mediated cell cycle gene regulation" set, against a background of the 15,879 genes actually tested (baseMean>10). Under the ratio-of-proportions OR variant it would be ~2.9; the exact gseapy/Enrichr value may therefore land roughly in the 2.5–4.5 range. The executed script (out/analysis_executed.py) automatically uses real gseapy.enrichr(Reactome_2022) when networked tooling is available and only falls back offline, so a runner re-execution with network would yield the canonical value.
